name: crenellation
description: Battlement ring (垛口): merlons spaced along the wall-top perimeter of a rectangle, corners always merlons.
when_to_use: Towers, castle walls, keeps — any build whose style card calls for crenellation. origin = wall footprint corner, y = first layer above the top wall block.

origin.notes: north-west corner of the wall footprint; y = layer above wall top

material.notes: wall-type blocks read best; full blocks also work
